description: What an ERC-20 token's contract can do and how much of it exists, read from the chain: mint, pause, blacklist and upgrade powers, owner, proxy, source verification, supply, and an unlock schedule you give set against it. It names what the code allows. A clean reading never means safe, and it cannot detect a rug pull.

announced_max_supply.description: The maximum supply the project states, in whole tokens.

schedule.description: The unlock schedule the project announces, in whole tokens. The chain does not state one, so it comes from you.

name: token_check

outputSchema.description: contract.powers says which standard functions the bytecode holds.
